methodology.controlled_comparison: Keep identical equity/gold risk balance, daily volatility target and target-change band. Compare the original four-factor equity sleeve against a50%four-factor/50%unleveragedNasdaq100equity sleeve.
methodology.factor_core: The four factor ETFs are equally weighted inside the factor core. The satellite cannot replace the entire core or be presented as a new economic factor.
methodology.risk_balance: At completed month ends, estimate63-session volatility of the actual composed equity sleeve and GLD. Inverse-volatility balance them with30%-70%equity bounds and2%idle cash.
methodology.daily_risk: Project the latest monthly target to12%predicted annual volatility using trailing63-session covariance, including BIL. Scale down all risky positions together and put the reduction in BIL. Never lever up.
methodology.trading: Emit a target at month ends or when the projected allocation differs by at least5percentage points from the last issued target. This is target-change hysteresis, not an actual-position or continuous drawdown guarantee.
methodology.costs: Same USD10,000,USD1per order,5bpnext-open base and20bpone-extra-session stress. The source-bound generic reviewer regenerates every target and cash path.
methodology.data: QQQ comes from the same previously audited original source manifest as SPY and defensive ETFs. No new provider vintage, synthetic history or leverage.
methodology.attribution: Any improvement may come from growth/technology market beta, not independent factor alpha. No diversification benefit is assumed; risk/return outcomes must be reported against the matched control.
methodology.selection_bias: This fixed experiment is motivated after96prior trials. No growth-weight grid or subsequent volatility/band tuning is permitted in this version.
